The assigned Second Printing rulebook incorporates the core procedural corrections, including forced prize-piece reuse, empty Court, deployment boundaries, Region Loss and Elephant priority. Corrected setup cards supply Bengal's 1758 control token and 1813 control/share-value tokens. Printed card corrections also specify: Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing a check to zero dice means failure; Company Fraud is played at start of Revenue: roll one die per your officeholder, reduce Balance by twice the highest roll (minimum zero), and take cash from the bank equal to that actual Balance reduction; Public Demands Impeachment returns member to supply and office card to vacancies; Military Oversight demotes one Commander to an officer, then appoints a Commander from officers: **the SAME former Commander remains eligible to become COMMANDER again**. These are card-specific effects, not changes to the normal check/hiring procedures.
